jobs.prompt: Read-only triage of held tickets. Input: coordination/review/held-input-9.json (tickets: T-0109, T-0110, T-0121, T-0122, T-0166, T-0207). For EACH ticket decide from the CURRENT repo code and git log (git log --oneline --all, git log -S, grep for the feature by meaning, not only the file name: the ticket's named file may not exist because the feature was built under another file name, e.g. board federation in tools/board-peers.mjs, split quality metrics and tests/split-quality.test.mjs, the machine and version-drift badge in tools/watch-assets/board.js, manager tests under tests/managers/) one verdict: 'delivered' (the acceptance lines are already met on main; cite a commit hash and PR number #N from git log and one file:line), 'release' (not built; a worker could do it now), or 'cancel' (obsolete or superseded; say what replaced it). Be strict: only 'delivered' with real evidence. Write ONE file coordination/review/held-verdict-9.json: [{"id":"T-xxxx","verdict":"delivered|release|cancel","evidence":"<=160 chars"}]. Do not edit any other file.
